title: Transferring Online Cases to Field Placements
description: Artifact-specific exemplar for CAT 531 connecting transferring online cases to field placements to DTS tension map, social annotation signals, and adaptive learner-model evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze a DTS tension map as evidence of learner judgment in CAT 531.
